display.purpose: Default h1; source media queries provide narrow-screen and welcome overrides.

headline.purpose: Default h2; rail and welcome contexts override size.

title.purpose: Card h3 with wrapped titles and 1.35 line-height.

body.purpose: Root DM Sans stack and line-height. Root font-size is not explicitly set. Self-hosted Latin and Latin Extended normal variable weights 400–700 use swap and no synthesis. Component specimens inherit loaded font faces from the host; otherwise the documented fallback stack applies.

excerpt.purpose: Three-line-clamped research notes; inherits root family and normal weight.

prose.purpose: Whitespace-preserving notes, up to 70ch; inherits root family.

label.purpose: Sentence-case form labels with inherited family and line-height.

button.purpose: Button elements use line-height 1.3; anchor buttons inherit 1.55. Family is inherited.

badge.purpose: Existing compact status/sample pills only; not a recommended minimum body size.

quote.purpose: Tabular numerals, total quote rather than nightly rate.

quote-total.purpose: Tabular numerals in the supporting detail panel.

shadows.name: idea-hover
shadows.purpose: Research-card hover only; cards are unshadowed at rest.

motion.name: button-state
motion.purpose: Shared button transition; default CSS ease.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All elements and pseudo-elements when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.

motion.name: toast-timeout
motion.purpose: JavaScript visibility duration, not an animation token.

narrative.overview:
Personal, approachable trip planning remains the incumbent character. The approved group-research rework expresses it through warm off-white ground, deep green navigation, teal actions, and quiet paper working surfaces. It is a working research space for a trusted group, not a luxury travel storefront or a corporate dashboard.

Typography and grouping carry the hierarchy. Contributor initials, outlined SVG symbols, and visible interest and discussion controls make participation legible without photography. Estimates, preferences, and booking decisions remain distinct; sample content stays visibly labeled.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ground, paper surfaces, and teal actions anchored by deep green navigation.
Self-hosted DM Sans, sentence-case hierarchy, and compact supporting metadata.
Bordered research cards with visible attribution and interest controls.
Responsive rails that become normal-flow navigation and stacked content.
Native links and forms with small progressive JavaScript conveniences.

rules.name: The Action and Decision Rule
rules.body: Teal identifies actions; labeled status tints identify decisions. Interest is a preference, not a booking.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Planner headings, forms, and reading text use DM Sans; legacy display typography does not leak into new planner surfaces.

rules.name: The Rails Become Content Rule
rules.body: On smaller screens, navigation and supporting rails enter normal flow; the planner does not introduce an overlay drawer or fixed bottom navigation.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Preserve tonal separation and borders at rest; use the shipped small shadows only for their documented roles.

dos: Do preserve warm ground, paper work surfaces, deep green navigation, and teal action hierarchy.
Do use self-hosted DM Sans and the documented sentence-case hierarchy on planner surfaces.
Do retain visible focus, labeled SVG controls, attribution, and interest state beyond color alone.
Do keep estimates, preferences, bookings, and clearly labeled sample content distinct.
Do use native links and forms and let supporting rails stack into normal flow.
donts: Don't reintroduce the stale terracotta/Outfit specification or merge the legacy stylesheet into the planner.
Don't replace SVG symbols with emoji, glyph icons, or decorative raster assets for these planner components.
Don't convert every tint into a brand accent or ban contextual blue, white, borders, or subtle shadows that the implementation uses.
Don't treat synthetic tonal ramps, compact metadata sizes, or the bounded six-fix ship verdict as approval for unreviewed visual changes.
